GMM.AreaTool: Map an area (drag a box on a city scene)
GMM.AreaNotCity: Map Maker: open a city scene and drag the box there.
GMM.AreaConfirm: Build a battle map of this area?
GMM.GMOnly: Only the GM can use Georgios' Map Maker.
GMM.NoToken: Set the companion token in the module settings first (it is in data/companion-token.txt).
GMM.CompanionUrlHint: Where the Georgios' Map Maker companion runs. Usually http://127.0.0.1:47110 on the GM's computer.
GMM.ImportWorldHint: Bring in a world map and its journals from Data/georgios-map-maker/worlds (made by the companion's world-build). Importing again replaces the earlier import.
GMM.WayUpHint: Click to go there; Shift-click to take everyone there.
GMM.TokenHint: Copy it from data/companion-token.txt in the companion folder. Stored only in this browser.
GMM.ResolutionHint: Resolution of the scene background. Higher looks sharper but makes bigger files.
GMM.Hint: Describe the map you want, for example: a smugglers' tavern by the docks at night, with a cellar and two guest rooms.
GMM.Placeholder: Describe a map, or ask for a change...
GMM.OpenedDungeondraft: Opened in Dungeondraft. Save there (Ctrl+S) and your edits come back here.

Clock.StepHint: Move the clock one segment on. Right-click: one back.
Clock.Fold: Fold the clock. Drag the bar to move it; double-click it to put it back at the top.
Clock.DateHint: Click: skip time, go to a date, set the weather
Clock.WeatherHint: By the season, every new segment the weather may change by these chances, a step at a time (clear, overcast, drizzle, rain, storm; light snow, snow, blizzard), the same in every scene and for everyone. Pick one to keep it until you set it back; the season carries on from it.

Launcher.Title: Companions
Launcher.UrlHint: Where Georgios' launcher answers on this PC. It starts the companions for you. Leave the default unless you changed its port.
Launcher.NoLauncher: Georgios' launcher is not running, so Foundry cannot start the companions. It starts when you log in to Windows; to start it now, double-click "Georgios Launcher.vbs" in your Startup folder (Win+R, shell:startup).
Launcher.NotRunning: The {name} is not running. Start it now?
Launcher.Starting: Starting the {name}. This takes a minute or two.
Launcher.Slow: The {name} did not answer within three minutes. Its log is in georgios-launcher/logs.

Route.Title: Route by name
Route.Click: Route: click towns on the world map
Route.ClickHint: Map Maker: click the town to start from, then any towns to pass through, then the last one. Right-click takes back the last town; Shift-click starts a new route.
Route.NotWorldMap: Map Maker: open the world map to click a route on it.
Route.NoTown: Map Maker: no town there. Click on a town's pin.
Route.Started: Map Maker: the route starts at {town}. Click the next town.
Route.ViaHint: towns to pass, in order, split by commas (optional)
Route.Cleared: Map Maker: the way is gone from the world map.
Route.NothingToClear: Map Maker: no way is drawn on the world map.
Route.NeedEnds: Map Maker: name the town to start from and the town to reach.
Route.DrawnShown: Drawn on "{scene}", where the players see it too.
Route.DrawnOn: Drawn on "{scene}", hidden from the players. To show it to them, open the Drawings tools, right-click a piece of the way and click the eye.
